verdict.rationale: A long-term user reports that Langfuse publishes an OpenAPI spec they implemented against in other languages. That is hands-on evidence that a machine-readable spec of the product's own API exists. However, no first-party doc in the pack says where to download it, and a probe of common spec paths (openapi.json, swagger.json, .well-known) on langfuse.com returned 404, so discoverability is unproven. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of a downloadable OpenAPI spec, a verified download URL, and evidence of spec completeness or versioning.
